entry.title: Sing, move, and answer a rhythm
entry.summary: Share a song you enjoy, copy a movement your child makes, or listen to a piece of music together. There is no need to perform well.
entry.cue: Notice a sway, a clap, a repeated sound, or a wish to hear a song again.
detail: Davies includes spontaneous songs with actions, family and cultural dances, and copying the rhythm a child makes. You can make room for their response as well as offer your own.

Listening can be an activity in itself. Give the music a moment of attention, instead of always leaving it behind other noise. Short rhymes with finger or body actions are another way to share rhythm.
